messages:
jess: Heads-up — noticed a tenant hit a big quota shock right after we flipped the new sticky-routing rule. cost dashboard shows a ~6x jump in token spend and cache misses for that tenant. anyone else seeing this pattern?

matt: saw the alert, digging. looks like most of the extra tokens are from fallback to the heavier model variant when the pinned instance was momentarily OOS. :grimacing:

jess: yeah the timeline lines up with the sticky policy toggle at 14:02 UTC. the dashboard only shows aggregate token burn, hard to attribute to routing change.

liam: could we add a "predicted delta" column on the rollout preview that shows expected token delta if routing policy switches? rough calc: marginal_cost ~= (p_fallback * (cost_fallback - cost_primary)) * invocations.

anika: +1 for predicted delta. also need a soft-cap option in the rollout UX — something that warns and auto-rolls-back if spend > X% over baseline for 15m. customers will hate surprise bills.

matt: agree on soft-cap. for immediate triage I ran a quick telemetry query:

```
-- approximate
SELECT route, model_variant, count(*) as calls, sum(tokens) as tokens
FROM invocations
WHERE tenant_id = 'T-1234' AND ts BETWEEN '2026-06-10T13:55Z' AND '2026-06-10T14:10Z'
GROUP BY route, model_variant;
```

matt: result shows route /chat/agent had 72% of calls moved to variant v2-heavy during the window. cache hit rate dropped from 84% -> 21%.

jess: oy. that explains token delta. is cache key shape stable between variants? maybe v2-heavy has different prompt expansion so cache ineffective.

liam: correct — v2-heavy prepends a system trace layer we didn't account for in fingerprinting. fix options: normalize fingerprinting across variants or compute and display "variant cache hit rate" in the preview.

anika: if we expose variant-specific cache hit predictions in the rollout modal, product can see "expected cache delta" and projected $/day impact before enabling. UX note: make the prediction low-friction — one line estimate + a link to expand details.

matt: for telemetry folks: I pushed a small metric `route.variant.cache_hit_rate` to prod at 14:20 so we can graph per-variant hit rates retroactively.

ops-bot: [alert] quota-usage spike detected for tenant T-1234 at 2026-06-10T14:03Z. current spend rate: 18x baseline.

jess: thanks. next steps: (1) add predicted token delta + cache delta to rollout preview, (2) add soft-cap rollback option, (3) short-term: disable sticky flip for that tenant and patch fingerprinting.

liam: i'll prototype the preview column — can we surface a CI-safe formula that uses recent samples? propose using 7d baseline median for hit rate and simulated fallback probability from recent latency/errors.

anika: i'll mock the UI affordance for soft-cap and the one-line estimate. will put in Figma and link here once done. :rocket:

matt: i'll create a telemetry board with the per-variant hit rate + marginal cost panel so PMs can validate predicted vs actual after rollout.

jess: great, thanks team. tagging @matt @liam @anika for follow-ups.

matt: filing follow-up ticket: INF-8702 (rollout-preview: token & cache delta + soft-cap).
